02675180-cc09-4d57-aa33-1ee0e351d591.action: Turn on 1-minute monitoring and record network traffic (VPC Flow Logs).
02675180-cc09-4d57-aa33-1ee0e351d591.analogy: Like a guard who glances at the cameras every five minutes.

inaction.detail: Without an audit trail or logs, a break-in is found later, and breaches that last more than 200 days averaged $5.65 million against $4.32 million for faster ones.
inaction.headline: Breaches take 247 days on average to find and contain
inaction.source_name: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2026

02675180-cc09-4d57-aa33-1ee0e351d591.title: The internet-facing server is only checked every 5 minutes
02675180-cc09-4d57-aa33-1ee0e351d591.what_could_happen: Short attacks and spikes fall between checks, so an intrusion is noticed later.

458d3366-73cc-4245-bc41-bb9f75077e80.action: No change needed for cost. The private storage route is its own item.
458d3366-73cc-4245-bc41-bb9f75077e80.analogy: Like worrying about tolls on a road that has none.
458d3366-73cc-4245-bc41-bb9f75077e80.title: No extra data-transfer charge here
458d3366-73cc-4245-bc41-bb9f75077e80.what_could_happen: Nothing: transfer between the server and S3 in the same region is free. The reviewer corrected this finding.

600b9ca4-c98e-4386-a9d6-de27672b7067.action: Declare the bucket's encryption in the code, with your own key for sensitive data.
600b9ca4-c98e-4386-a9d6-de27672b7067.analogy: Like a safe that came with a factory lock nobody chose or wrote down.

fix.caveat: Declaring S3's default encryption is free; a customer-managed key adds about $1/month and lets you control who can decrypt.

inaction.detail: The global average cost of a breach, counting investigation, notification, lost business and fines. Breaches in the US averaged $11.5 million.
inaction.headline: Average data breach: $4.99 million

600b9ca4-c98e-4386-a9d6-de27672b7067.subject: cg-cardholder-data-bucket
600b9ca4-c98e-4386-a9d6-de27672b7067.title: The code doesn't say how stored files are encrypted
600b9ca4-c98e-4386-a9d6-de27672b7067.what_could_happen: S3 encrypts new files with an AWS-owned key by default, but nothing here chooses or records that, and nobody can limit who decrypts sensitive files.

624a4c66-8f2d-4c22-96af-0702aa6274ac.action: Run a second server in another data center behind the load balancer from the HTTPS fix, with automatic replacement.
624a4c66-8f2d-4c22-96af-0702aa6274ac.analogy: Like a shop with one cashier and no one to cover.

inaction.detail: Your 99.9% availability target allows about 44 minutes of downtime a month, and one failure here could use all of it. There's no fair average for downtime: it depends on the business.
inaction.headline: Every hour offline costs what the service earns or saves in an hour
inaction.method: Multiply your revenue (or staff time saved) per hour by the hours a failure would keep the service down.

624a4c66-8f2d-4c22-96af-0702aa6274ac.title: The whole platform runs on one server
624a4c66-8f2d-4c22-96af-0702aa6274ac.what_could_happen: A crash, a reboot for patching or a data-center problem takes the card platform offline until someone fixes it.

a5c4e002-aa8f-4088-a26e-3ba59830ba84.action: Add a free S3 gateway endpoint and let the bucket be reached only through it.
a5c4e002-aa8f-4088-a26e-3ba59830ba84.analogy: Like using a public road between two of your own buildings when a private tunnel is free.

inaction.detail: The global average cost of a breach, counting investigation, notification, lost business and fines. Breaches in the US averaged $11.5 million.
inaction.headline: Average data breach: $4.99 million
inaction.source_name: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2026

a5c4e002-aa8f-4088-a26e-3ba59830ba84.title: Storage traffic doesn't use a private route
a5c4e002-aa8f-4088-a26e-3ba59830ba84.what_could_happen: If the bucket's settings slip, nothing makes it refuse requests from outside your network. A private endpoint changes the route; a bucket policy that only accepts requests through it is what makes the bucket refuse outside traffic.

cb07d6a3-579d-4501-a42c-1b344acbc411.action: If no trail exists yet, turn one on that writes to a locked-down bucket.
cb07d6a3-579d-4501-a42c-1b344acbc411.analogy: Like a building that throws its sign-in sheet away after 90 days.

inaction.detail: Without an audit trail or logs, a break-in is found later, and breaches that last more than 200 days averaged $5.65 million against $4.32 million for faster ones.

cb07d6a3-579d-4501-a42c-1b344acbc411.title: The code doesn't set up a long-term record of who did what
cb07d6a3-579d-4501-a42c-1b344acbc411.what_could_happen: AWS keeps 90 days of account changes by default. Without a trail, nothing older is kept and file-level access isn't recorded, so an investigation could come up short. A trail may already exist outside this code, so check first.

cd120b0c-9d10-438e-ad83-4f61af51567c.action: Replace the broad AWS policy with one that names only the resources the code uses.
cd120b0c-9d10-438e-ad83-4f61af51567c.analogy: Like a delivery driver with keys to the whole warehouse.

cd120b0c-9d10-438e-ad83-4f61af51567c.subject: cg-banking-WAF-Role
cd120b0c-9d10-438e-ad83-4f61af51567c.title: Running code has far more access than it needs
cd120b0c-9d10-438e-ad83-4f61af51567c.what_could_happen: If the server or function is hacked, the attacker can reach everything this access allows, such as every storage bucket.

d4831d89-2615-442e-bf98-81d30627e116.action: Do all three fixes together: require IMDSv2, cut the server's access to what it needs, and limit the bucket to the private route with a bucket policy. No single fix is guaranteed to close the path, so test it once they're done.
d4831d89-2615-442e-bf98-81d30627e116.analogy: Like an unlocked side door, a front desk that hands out keys, and a master key on the ring, all at once.

inaction.detail: The global average cost of a breach, counting investigation, notification, lost business and fines. Breaches in the US averaged $11.5 million.
inaction.headline: Average data breach: $4.99 million
inaction.source_name: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2026

d4831d89-2615-442e-bf98-81d30627e116.title: Three gaps line up into a path to the card data
d4831d89-2615-442e-bf98-81d30627e116.what_could_happen: An attacker who tricks the web server can take its access keys and download or delete every card record. This is the pattern behind the 2019 Capital One breach.

e0eff08e-bd54-4d2f-bb01-ac17890eb13d.action: Require IMDSv2 tokens on the server, a one-line setting.
e0eff08e-bd54-4d2f-bb01-ac17890eb13d.analogy: Like a hotel front desk that gives a room key to anyone who calls.

e0eff08e-bd54-4d2f-bb01-ac17890eb13d.subject: ec2-vulnerable-proxy-server
e0eff08e-bd54-4d2f-bb01-ac17890eb13d.title: The server hands out its access keys too easily
e0eff08e-bd54-4d2f-bb01-ac17890eb13d.what_could_happen: A common web flaw (SSRF) can trick the server into revealing its AWS keys. This is how the 2019 Capital One breach happened.

e61e6701-93c0-48e9-ba2a-db6097224bdd.action: Turn on all four of AWS's public-access blocks for the bucket.
e61e6701-93c0-48e9-ba2a-db6097224bdd.analogy: Like a filing cabinet whose lock can be switched off by one wrong setting.

e61e6701-93c0-48e9-ba2a-db6097224bdd.subject: cg-cardholder-data-bucket
e61e6701-93c0-48e9-ba2a-db6097224bdd.title: A storage bucket isn't locked against public sharing
e61e6701-93c0-48e9-ba2a-db6097224bdd.what_could_happen: One mistaken permission change could put every file in it on the open internet.

e7983266-071a-48d5-9208-3b7cac99e75a.action: Serve the site over HTTPS with a free AWS certificate on a load balancer, and require HTTPS for storage calls.
e7983266-071a-48d5-9208-3b7cac99e75a.analogy: Like reading card numbers aloud on a phone line others can listen in on.

e7983266-071a-48d5-9208-3b7cac99e75a.title: Card data travels to the website unencrypted
e7983266-071a-48d5-9208-3b7cac99e75a.what_could_happen: Anyone on the network path can read or change what customers send, and it breaks PCI-DSS requirement 4.

e82d002f-ed0d-4a93-bb2e-d5cb5b3514ad.action: Turn on versioning so old copies are kept, with a rule that expires them.
e82d002f-ed0d-4a93-bb2e-d5cb5b3514ad.analogy: Like a document with no undo and no saved drafts.
